sources.limits: GAME_DESIGN §27 'Substituições na pausa: 5 em 3 paradas + intervalo (parametrizável)'; TEST_PLAN '11 ou menos jogadores por time em campo; substituições dentro do limite'. The limits themselves come from MatchSetup.MaxSubstitutions and match_rules.json substitutions.maxWindows
sources.attributes: TECHNICAL_SPEC §10 'Substituições | Mesmas regras e IA' and CLAUDE.md §7: the substitute plays with his own attributes (Balance.Eval). A sprinter (Velocidade/Agilidade 95) against a slow starter (30) must cover clearly more ground; minDistanceRatio is a DESIGN ESTIMATE
sources.headless: DESIGN ESTIMATE (A9c, X-77), 4-min matches strong × weak (vertical slice with its bench): the AI replaces some tired players at half-time and at the 60/70/80 windows, never more than maxTiredSubstitutions per side; measured 2.6 per match (both sides) at the X-77 baseline
sources.redCard: Seeds searched for a dismissal (≈0.1 red per 4-min match, Data/TestRanges/referee.json rhythm) to check that a sent-off player cannot be substituted
